name: K-C New Milford Mill - New Milford CT
type: Diaper & tissue manufacturing plant (Huggies, Kleenex, Scott)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or staffed checkpoint clearly visible from satellite. The complex shares a dense industrial park and the only Street View coverage (2019-2022) is of the office/commercial frontage on Pickett District Rd, where there is no gate. A controlled truck gate on the internal yard road cannot be confirmed or ruled out - set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any imaged entrance. Set false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the Housatonic River on the east edge of the property with rail cars (boxcars/hoppers) parked on it - consistent with a rail siding serving the mill. Marked true with medium confidence; flagged uncertain because the spur connection into the property is partly tree-obscured.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple dock faces and drop yards on different building faces (north drop yard near the main mill, plus a separate yard with trailers to the SE) - physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main diaper/tissue mill, an attached utility/boiler plant, office buildings, and a wastewater treatment area.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yards with ~60 trailers visible in angled rows; banded 25-50 for marked drop stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~25 doors estimated; much of the building face is obscured by process equipment and roof structures - honest estimate, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible from overhead; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - the mill sits inside a dense industrial/commercial corridor of New Milford CT (Pickett District Rd).
